record.name: GitHub
record.one_liner: GitHub REST API for creating integrations, retrieving repository data, and automating developer workflows
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free GitHub account and generate personal access tokens or configure OAuth apps self-serve.
record.api_note: The API covers repositories, issues, pull requests, actions, users, organizations, and nearly all platform features across hundreds of endpoints.

evidence.quote: Create an access token. For example, create a personal access token or a GitHub App user access token.
Create integrations, retrieve data, and automate your workflows with the GitHub REST API.
The GitHub MCP server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provided and maintained by GitHub.

evidence_checks.quote: Create an access token. For example, create a personal access token or a GitHub App user access token.
Create integrations, retrieve data, and automate your workflows with the GitHub REST API.
The GitHub MCP server is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provided and maintained by GitHub.

auth.why: Evidence only shows token auth, no mention of OAuth2 as primary method.

access.why: Evidence mentions creating a token but does not confirm free self‑service sign‑up.

mcp.why: Official docs state GitHub provides an MCP server.

verdict.why: Partial evidence; auth and access claims not fully substantiated.
